EventDisplay.Name: Lunch & Learn "Employee Benefits 101"
EventDisplay.Description:
The B/CS Chamber of Commerce and Colonial Life – Baker Insurance Agency invite you to a Lunch and Learn event covering "Employee Benefits 101: What Every Employer Should Know" on Monday, September 14th from 11:45 a.m. until 1 p.m.

Employee Benefits 101: What Every Employer Should Know
  1. Why Employee Benefits Matter
    • How benefits help attract, retain, and engage employees.
  2. Understanding the Core Benefits
    • Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability coverage explained.
  3. Voluntary Benefits and Employee Choice
    • Accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and supplemental benefits that help employees manage out-of-pocket expenses.
  4. Tax-Advantaged Benefits & COBRA
    • Understanding HRAs, HSAs, Healthcare FSAs, Dependent Care FSAs, and COBRA continuation coverage, including how these programs can reduce costs and create tax advantages for employers and employees.
  5. Building a Benefits Package on Any Budget
    • Practical benefit strategies for small and growing businesses that balance cost and employee value.
Employee Benefits 101: A Practical Guide for Employers
Employee benefits can be confusing, but they don't have to be. This session will provide business owners, managers, and HR professionals with a straightforward overview of today's employee benefits landscape. Learn the basics of core and voluntary benefits, explore tax-saving tools such as HRAs, HSAs, Healthcare FSAs, Dependent Care FSAs, and COBRA, and discover practical strategies for creating a competitive benefits package that fits your budget. Whether you have 2 employees or 3,000, you'll leave with practical knowledge and actionable ideas you can use immediately.

EventDisplay.Name: Lunch & Learn "Understanding Senior Living Options"
EventDisplay.Description:
Lunch & Learn: Understanding Senior Living Options

Making decisions about senior care can feel overwhelming—but it doesn't have to be.

Join the Bryan/College Station Chamber of Commerce for an informative Lunch & Learn featuring a panel of local senior living and healthcare professionals who will help you understand the differences between today's senior care options. Whether you're planning ahead for yourself, helping aging parents navigate their next chapter, or simply want to be prepared for the future, this conversation will provide valuable insights and practical guidance.
Our expert panel will discuss:
  • Independent Living
  • Assisted Living
  • Skilled Nursing & Rehabilitation
  • Memory Care
Learn what services each option provides, who may benefit most from each level of care, when it may be time to consider a transition, and how to begin planning before a crisis occurs. You'll also have the opportunity to ask questions and hear from professionals who work with seniors and their families every day.
This program is ideal for:
  • Adult children helping parents explore senior living options
  • Seniors planning for their future independence and care
  • Caregivers and family members seeking trusted local resources
  • Professionals who work with older adults and their families
Enjoy lunch while gaining the knowledge and confidence to make informed decisions for yourself or your loved ones.
